_about: PEOPLE 10/18, row [heirs backgrounds] A-KILLER'S-KID-COMES-PREPARED, under the hold (rule 88: a page is the ship). trade_follows.source: US Census Bureau, Current Population Reports P23-11, Lifetime Occupational Mobility of Adult Males: March 1962 (1964), https://www.census.gov/library/publications/1964/demo/p23-011.html
numbers: 23 percent of men 25 to 64 worked in the same major occupation group as their father
about 41 percent of professionals' sons matched their fathers
sons of clerical, sales, service and labourer fathers matched at roughly 10 to 15 percent
85 percent of farmers had farmer fathers (inflow, the other direction; not used as a share)
trade_follows.said: read through search text; the report itself did not open from this container. Major occupation GROUPS, so the true same-trade number is lower than these, never higher.

traits_pass.source: Vukasovic and Bratko 2015, Heritability of personality: a meta-analysis of behavior genetic studies, Psychological Bulletin, https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25961374/
numbers: average heritability of personality .40 across 62 effect sizes and over 100,000 people
twin studies .47, family and adoption studies .22
traits_pass.rule: a parent and child share half their genes, so for an additive trait the parent-child correlation is about half the heritability (Falconer, the standard quantitative-genetics result, from memory, said so): personality about .20, a highly heritable body trait (height h2 about .8, from memory) about .40

trait_classes._about: every trait on Battle Brothers' Traits page, each in exactly one class (ours: the classing is this lane's reading, the shares are the real studies'). BODY passes like a body (about .40), MIND like a temperament (about .20), EARNED never passes by blood (a life made it), CHANCE never passes (luck is not a gene).

notes.Drunkard: MIND, not EARNED: the risk runs in families (alcohol use disorder heritability about .5 in twin studies, from memory, said so)
notes.Fat: EARNED: Battle Brothers makes it at a table, by an event
notes.Hate for Beasts: EARNED, and the one an heir can be BORN into: see death_leaves
